phase_name: Clean-clone CI rehearsal and the reintroduced-mismatch negative test

objectives.description: git clone into scratchpad, confirm no .claude/
Execute Phase 5 workflow's step commands against the clone verbatim
Positive case: full verify-deploy.sh run exits 0 with 0 findings
Negative case: reintroduce line_count mismatch, confirm non-zero exit naming the file
Revert the deliberate edit in the clone, confirm green again
Record both transcripts in progress file as acceptance evidence

approaches_tried.approach: First positive-case rehearsal attempt (before fixing gate8 regression)
approaches_tried.reason: gate8 (tests/run-all.sh) failed: test-deploy-propagation.sh and test-deploy-orphans.sh create bare `git init` scratch repos with no .gitignore, so gate14 (check-runtime-file-tracking.sh, wired in Phase 3) correctly failed Check A on the nested throwaway repo inside the test harness, causing deploy-headless.sh to exit 3 and the test's run_deploy() to report 'deploy did not complete'. Root-caused via direct probe (git init + deploy-headless.sh + check-runtime-file-tracking.sh) confirming Check A fails on a never-onboarded repo. Fixed by seeding the 'Consumer Repo Setup' .gitignore block (from context/standards/orchestrator-runtime-files.md) into both test harnesses' scratch TARGET before their first commit -- this makes the fixture representative of a properly-onboarded consumer repo, without relaxing gate14 or the tests' own deploy-propagation assertions. Verified: both harnesses pass standalone (4/4 and 5/5 assertions), full tests/run-all.sh = 52 passed 0 failed locally, then the clone rehearsal re-run confirmed 25 checks 0 failures.

deviations.description: Fix the 16 pre-existing Rule R line_count mismatches (originally Phase 7's job) during Phase 6
deviations.reason: Phase 6's positive case requires 0 findings, but the pre-existing Rule R mismatches (present since before this task started, unrelated to Phases 1-5's own edits) were still live at the point Phase 6 runs (wave 5, before Phase 7's wave 6). Phase 6 explicitly authorizes 'fix the underlying cause at the source and re-run -- do not relax the gate' for any failing gate encountered during rehearsal, so generate-context-line-counts.sh --write was run in the working repo (not the rehearsal clone) to close Rule R, committed, and the clone was re-cloned from the updated HEAD before rehearsing. Phase 7 still performs its own final regeneration sweep afterward, which is a lighter confirmatory pass (absorbing only the new ci-deploy-tree-bootstrap.md doc's own line_count) rather than a duplicate of this fix.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- Rule R fix pulled forward into Phase 6 to satisfy its own 0-findings acceptance criterion, per the phase's explicit 'fix at the source' authorization)*

deviations.description: Discovered and fixed a genuine regression: gate14 (added in Phase 3) breaks two shell-test-suite harnesses (test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-deploy-orphans.sh) that create bare, never-onboarded scratch git repos
deviations.reason: Not anticipated by the plan. The fix (seed the documented Consumer Repo Setup .gitignore block into both harnesses' scratch fixtures) is scoped to the test fixtures only -- gate14 itself, check-runtime-file-tracking.sh, and the tests' own deploy-propagation/orphan-detection assertions are unchanged. This is not a lint relaxation: gate14 continues to correctly fail any real, un-onboarded consumer repo; the fix only makes the test's throwaway fixture representative of a properly-onboarded one, which is what the harness is actually supposed to be testing against.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- fixed a gate14-caused test-fixture regression discovered during Phase 6's full-suite rehearsal, not present in Phase 1's --skip-slow baseline)*
